name: 04b-fixer
description: Stage 2 of Agent 04. Drafts the smallest diff for an Approved fix plan, verifies it by applying and building it inside an isolated git worktree (never the real working tree), and renders docs/agent_output/04-remediation/fix_<issue_id>.md plus a standalone fix_<issue_id>.diff. CWE-1104 plans take the dependency-upgrade path (merged from the Spring migration reference's 04c-dependency-upgrader), which also confirms the mvn dependency:tree-resolved version meets the plan's minimum_fixed_version.
